question: can the pinned deterministic build typeset a Korean body at all

measurements.test: pinned compiler on Korean text with the existing preamble
measurements.result: compiles, but the Korean characters are dropped from the output entirely
measurements.reading: the failure is silent: a PDF is produced and the text is simply absent

measurements.test: pinned compiler with fontspec and a font family name
measurements.extracted_text: Ⅰ. 서론 자율 연구 엔진의 설계와 평가를 다룬다.

measurements.test: same change inside the validator isolated build
measurements.error: compiler dependency escaped the isolated source/toolchain roots
measurements.reading: the isolation rule admits dependencies only from the toolchain root or the temporary build directory, and a system font is outside both

finding: Korean typesetting is possible under the pinned compiler, but only with a font inside the isolation boundary. The isolation gate refused the system font correctly, and that refusal is the reason the change was not made this cycle.
chosen_path: mint a new pinned toolchain revision containing a redistributable Korean font, then set the manuscript main font by family name so no absolute path enters the manuscript bytes

rejected_alternatives.option: keep the English body for the PDF and put Korean only in the Word artifact
rejected_alternatives.why_rejected: that creates two canonical sources, which the manuscript policy forbids

rejected_alternatives.option: weaken the isolation rule to admit system fonts
rejected_alternatives.why_rejected: the rule is the reason the build is reproducible; loosening it to pass a check would remove the guarantee it exists to provide

rejected_alternatives.option: place the font beside the manuscript in the source directory
rejected_alternatives.why_rejected: the isolated build treats any extra file in the source directory as a violation as well

why_deferred: minting a toolchain revision changes a pinned digest that every prior build receipt refers to, so it is done as its own unit rather than at the end of a long session
state_left_behind: the manuscript is unchanged and validation passes; nothing is half-applied
